name: patronvault-worker
description: PatronVault pilot surface: the member page and exact-bytes terms at scan.djzs.ai/patron, the status API, and the cron keeper that settles each member once per period.

scripts.check: npm run gen:terms && tsc --noEmit -p . && tsc --noEmit -p site
scripts.dry: npm run build:site && DJZS_BUILD_ONLY=1 wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir /tmp/patronvault-dry
scripts.deploy: npm run build:site && wrangler deploy --tag "$(git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD)" --message "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
